findings.summary: Converting offset to a page number drops the remainder, so offsets that aren't multiples of limit return the wrong items (e.g., offset=10, limit=20 returns items 0–19 instead of 10–29).

judge.reason: Page-based conversion drops remainder for non-multiple offsets; a real separate defect (though it relies on page semantics).
